visual: Arching grey-green leaves striped cream-white · evergreen fountain · yellow flowers
soilWarning: Avoid heavy soil · shelter from severe frost
prune: Remove damaged or tired leaves in spring
cvs: cultivar code 'Roma 13'; RHS trade synonym PLATINUM BEAUTY
hardinessNote: Breeder gives tolerance to -10°C; mapped to RHS H4
uncertain: Plantipp markets the plant as WHITE SANDS ('Roma 13'), while RHS currently uses PLATINUM BEAUTY ('Roma 13') and lists White Sands as a synonym
some Australian sources describe the plant as involving Lomandra confertifolia subsp. pallida, while RHS and Plantipp list it under Lomandra longifolia
H4 is inferred by mapping the breeder's stated -10°C tolerance onto the RHS hardiness scale
Plantipp records EU PBR 52998; a separate UK plant-right registration was not verified, so compliance is left blank
hue and rating scores are editorial conversions from researched characteristics
